product_one_liner.value: WindBorne combines observations from long-duration weather balloons with proprietary AI models to provide weather forecasts and intelligence for energy, transportation, agriculture, and emergency-response organizations.
product_one_liner.notes: The homepage describes combining balloon observations with AI forecasting; the product page names its own models, and the funding announcement identifies the sectors served. Sources: https://windbornesystems.com/, https://windbornesystems.com/products/forecasts, and https://windbornesystems.com/blog/windborne-systems-raises-37-million-to-build-the-worlds-weather-intelligence-infrastructure.

pricing_page.notes: No pricing link was found in the inspected homepage navigation/footer, and /pricing returned no readable page. The site directs visitors to contact the team, and the documentation directs commercial-access inquiries to email. Sources: https://windbornesystems.com/ and https://api.windbornesystems.com/getting-started.

named_customers.notes: named_customers: The company explicitly calls NOAA an operational customer and identifies prior contracts with the Air Force and Navy, establishing customer relationships rather than merely partnerships: https://windbornesystems.com/blog/windborne-wins-u-s-navy-air-force-awards-to-accelerate-its-groundbreaking-ai-weather-forecasting-models-and-enable-operational-govt-models. | named_customers.0: WindBorne explicitly identifies NOAA as an operational customer since early 2023. | named_customers.1: The announcement explicitly identifies prior contracts with the Air Force, establishing a contracted customer relationship.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 101 employees, which maps to the 101–200 band. This is a third-party count without an explicit headcount measurement date: https://tracxn.com.

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The homepage explicitly identifies Redwood Shores, California, as the company’s base. The location is retained as stated by the company: https://windbornesystems.com/. | hq_country: The company’s legal policy explicitly states that WindBorne is based in the United States: https://windbornesystems.com/ext/legal.

founded_year.notes: The official team biography explicitly says John Dean co-founded WindBorne in 2019: http://windbornesystems.com/team.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering content exists, but only the WeatherMesh-4 post explicitly established an engineer author. Other technical articles examined did not establish their authors, so the stipulated requirement for two engineer-authored posts was not met. This is a conservative classification, not a claim that technical content is absent. Sources: https://windbornesystems.com/blog and https://www.windbornesystems.com/blog/weathermesh-4-technical-blog.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal contains separate Getting Started, Authentication, Point Forecast, and gridded/interpolated forecast reference pages, satisfying the multipage documentation requirement: https://api.windbornesystems.com/.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official Machine Learning Research Engineer, Model Evaluation posting contains an application link and no closure notice: https://windbornesystems.com/careers/machine-learning-research-engineer-model-evaluation.

model_provider.value: WindBorne’s own WeatherMesh-6 Global and WM-6 3km AI models, plus its blended MetaMesh model.
model_provider.notes: The forecasts page explicitly identifies WeatherMesh-6 Global, WM-6 3km, and MetaMesh as WindBorne’s model portfolio: https://windbornesystems.com/products/forecasts.

compliance_certs.notes: The legal, privacy, and cookie policies were readable but contained no explicit claim of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS compliance; general privacy-law language was not counted: https://windbornesystems.com/ext/legal.

last_funding.notes: funding_stage: Both the latest-round profile and WindBorne’s announcement identify Series B funding. Sources: https://tracxn.com and https://windbornesystems.com/blog/windborne-systems-raises-37-million-to-build-the-worlds-weather-intelligence-infrastructure. | funding_date: The funding profile dates the round July 31, 2026, so the recorded round month is 2026-07. The company announcement was published August 5, 2026; announcement month and recorded round month therefore differ. Sources: https://tracxn.com and https://windbornesystems.com/blog/windborne-systems-raises-37-million-to-build-the-worlds-weather-intelligence-infrastructure. | funding_amount_usd: The funding profile records the latest Series B amount as $37,124,969; WindBorne’s public announcement reports the rounded amount of $37 million. Sources: https://tracxn.com and https://windbornesystems.com/blog/windborne-systems-raises-37-million-to-build-the-worlds-weather-intelligence-infrastructure.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 5, 2026 announcement reports a $37 million Series B, clearly within the preceding 18 months: https://windbornesystems.com/blog/windborne-systems-raises-37-million-to-build-the-worlds-weather-intelligence-infrastructure.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official Enterprise Account Executive — Utilities posting contains an application link and no closure notice: https://windbornesystems.com/careers/enterprise-account-executive----utilities.

launched_6mo.notes: The October 29, 2026 announcement introduces WindBorne Weather Events and says the formerly internal tracker is now available through the API, within the six-month window: https://windbornesystems.com/blog.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying dated appointment or departure could be verified. The current executive chart lists ten executives but masks several names and provides no joining dates; the older official team page does not establish complete current leadership coverage. Unknown is therefore safer than asserting no change. Sources: https://www.theofficialboard.com/org-chart/windborne-systems?showSubsidiary=open and http://windbornesystems.com/team.

crm_stack_signal.notes: crm_stack_signal: The GTM Lead posting names HotJar, PostHog, and Mixpanel as relevant analytics tools. These are hiring-stack signals, not confirmation that all three are deployed; no named CRM was established. Source: https://www.windbornesystems.com/careers/growth-lead. | crm_stack_signal.0: HotJar is explicitly named as an example analytics tool in the GTM Lead posting; deployment is not confirmed. | crm_stack_signal.1: PostHog is explicitly named as an example analytics tool in the GTM Lead posting; deployment is not confirmed. | crm_stack_signal.2: Mixpanel is explicitly named as an example analytics tool in the GTM Lead posting; deployment is not confirmed.
